verdict.rationale: Vestd documents shareholder communications sent directly from the platform, with segmented mailing lists for targeted updates (vestd-docs-13, vestd-docs-3). Its data rooms let the company share cap tables and shareholder documents with chosen people (vestd-docs-21). A dedicated shareholder-dashboards page suggests investors get their own login view (vestd-docs-37), but the evidence only implies a per-investor holdings view rather than describing it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of what investors see in their own holdings portal, detail on how updates are structured (e.g., KPI or investor-update templates), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
